items.name: SUB · Listening post · label and alert
items.what: Removes duplicates by item_id, labels each comment (sentiment, topic, urgent, intent, confidence) with local-language examples, applies the alert rules in code, saves to Mentions and alerts Tolu immediately on hard-rule items.
setup: Import this first and note its workflow ID.
Create a Google Sheet with a Mentions tab: source, item_id, link, posted_at, text, sentiment, topic, urgent, intent, confidence, level, alerted, handled_by.
Select your Google Sheets credential in the three sheet nodes and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Select your OpenAI credential and replace YOUR_MODEL with a small, cheap model.
Select your Telegram credential and replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
In workflow settings, set your error workflow from 3.6.
items.test: Click Test workflow with the pinned test comments: the food-safety comment alerts on Telegram straight away, the slang praise ('sick') is labelled positive and doesn't alert, and all three rows appear in Mentions. Run it again: nothing new is added or alerted.

walk.title: Build it: ears that only wake Tolu when it matters
walk.sample: 3 test comments · "My daughter was sick after eating the ugu" · "This pepper is sick 🔥" · "Price don cost o"

steps.say: Every 15 minutes, the collector gathers comments from your own Facebook Page and Instagram, plus web mentions from a Talkwalker Alerts feed, all through official routes, and hands them to this sub-workflow in one shape.
show: Sources: Facebook Graph API · Instagram API
Talkwalker Alerts RSS · Google review emails
Shape: source, item_id, link, posted_at, text

steps.say: This sub-workflow is called by each collector. Import it first and note its ID, because the collectors need it.
show: Called by: HL · Listening post · collect

steps.say: We read the Mentions sheet first. It stores comments and labels only: no phone numbers, no profiles of people.
show: source, item_id, link, text, sentiment, topic…

steps.say: Each comment's platform ID is checked against the sheet. Without this, one angry comment alerts Tolu thirty times in a day.
show: skip if item_id already in Mentions
skip if empty text or seen this run

steps.say: The extractor returns four labels, not one: sentiment, topic, urgent and intent, plus a confidence. A small, cheap model is enough for labelling.
The system message carries local examples: Pidgin, slang and sarcasm. Sick with a fire emoji is praise, and price don cost is about price, not anger.
We join the labels back onto the original comment, so the link and source travel with them.
The alert rules are code. Anything that can hurt someone, like food safety, a threat or sick after, alerts on a hard rule, never on a confidence score.
For the rest, only a confident negative about a refund or late delivery counts, and it waits for the 6 p.m. summary. Everything else goes in Monday's report.
show: && topic in refund, late delivery → today

steps.say: Every labelled comment is saved, with its level, and alerted set to no for now.
The switch sends each comment by level: now, today or report.
Urgent items go to Tolu on Telegram straight away, with the exact words and the link, so she can answer within hours, not nine days.
Then we mark it alerted, so it never alerts twice.
Monday at 8, code counts the week and AI writes three fixes quoting real comments. Monthly, re-measure against people and delete raw text older than 90 days.
show: Mon 08:00 report: code counts, AI explains

walk.end: Test it with the pinned comments: the sick-after-ugu comment alerts Tolu at once, the sick pepper stays praise, and a second run adds nothing.

items.name: HL · Listening post · collect
items.what: Every 15 minutes, collects Facebook Page comments, Instagram comments and Talkwalker Alerts mentions in one shape and sends them to the label-and-alert sub-workflow.
setup: Create a Facebook Graph API credential with your Page access token and select it in Facebook Page comments.
Create a Header Auth credential called "Meta page token": Name Authorization, Value Bearer followed by your Page access token. Select it in Instagram recent media and Instagram comments.
Replace YOUR_PAGE_ID, YOUR_IG_USER_ID (your Instagram Business account ID) and YOUR_TALKWALKER_RSS_URL (create a free brand alert delivered by RSS).
Replace YOUR_LABEL_WORKFLOW_ID with the ID of SUB · Listening post · label and alert.
Attach your error workflow (3.6) in workflow settings.
items.test: Comment on one of your Page's posts and one Instagram post, then click Test workflow. The sub-workflow execution shows both comments labelled and stored; running again adds nothing.

items.name: HL · Listening post · Google review emails
items.what: Feeds Google review notification emails into the same label-and-alert sub-workflow until you have Business Profile API access.
setup: Select the Gmail credential for the inbox that receives Google Business Profile notifications.
Check the sender address in the Gmail Trigger search matches your notification emails.
Replace YOUR_LABEL_WORKFLOW_ID.
items.test: Forward a review notification to that inbox (or wait for one) and check that it appears in Mentions with labels.

items.name: HL · Listening post · 18:00 summary
items.what: At 6 p.m. sends Tolu one Telegram message with the day's level-today items and marks them alerted.
setup: Select your Google Sheets credential in both sheet nodes and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Select your Telegram credential and replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
items.test: Add a test row to Mentions with level today and alerted no, then click Test workflow: one summary arrives and the row's alerted becomes yes.

items.name: HL · Listening post · Monday report
items.what: Every Monday at 08:00, code counts the week's labels against last week (spam excluded) and the AI writes three fixes with real quotes; sent by email with a Telegram summary.
setup: Select your Google Sheets credential and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Select your OpenAI credential and replace YOUR_MODEL.
Select a Gmail credential and replace YOUR_TOLU_EMAIL.
Select your Telegram credential and replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
items.test: With a week of labelled rows (or test rows), click Test workflow: the email shows totals, percent positive against last week, top topics, spam excluded and three fixes, each quoting a real comment.

items.name: HL · Listening post · monthly housekeeping
items.what: Monthly: clears raw comment text older than 90 days and reminds Tolu to grow and re-measure the reference set.
setup: Select your Google Sheets credential and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Select your Telegram credential and replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
items.test: Add a test row dated four months ago and click Test workflow: its text is emptied (labels kept) and the reminder arrives.
